product_metadata.title: SureFit Twill Supreme 2-Piece Sofa Slipcover, White
features: Relaxed Fit - Woven for a slightly loose and casual look with adjustability features that can be tucked or tied for a more tailored profile.
Designed to fit furniture with square or box cushions.
Adjustable arm height - set arm then adjust wrap around skirt with hem even with the floor.
Pleated back corners - remain open for larger overstuffed arms or fabric can be positioned forward and tucked into shoulder of furniture.
Elastic tabs - at back corners open and close to adjust to fit your furniture base circumference and omit the need for ties.
Side ruffles -are not attached to the side of the furniture cover to allow the arm height to adjust.
Front ruffle - rolls underneath the seat cushion mimicking the upholstery of the furniture.
description: This relaxed fit sofa slip cover is woven for a slightly loose and casual look with adjustability features that can be tucked or tied for a more tailored profile. It is designed to fit furniture with square or box cushions. The arm to arm guidelines for this slip cover are 74 inches – 96-inches, the arm width is 11-inches, arm height is 27-inches and this slipcover fits a seat depth up to 23-inches. The variable features are adjustable arm height, pleated corners, elastic tabs, side ruffles and front ruffles.
